metadata.title: Convergence of Generalized Kähler--Ricci Flow on Toric Fano Manifolds
metadata.abstract: We first define an extended Mabuchi functional for a class of generalized Kähler metrics of symplectic type on a toric Fano manifold $(M,J,\mathbb{T})$, and prove it is proper. Then by showing the monotonicity of functional along the normalized generalized Kähler-Ricci flow for any initial $\mathbb{T}$-invariant generalized Kähler metric with its symplectic form in $2\pi c_1(M,J)$, we prove that the flow converges to a Kähler-Ricci soliton. The result confirms a conjecture of Apostolov-Streets-Ustinovskiy.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: toric Fano 的广义 Kähler–Ricci 流收敛
analysis.workSummary: 构造并证明指定 symplectic-type generalized Kähler 类的 extended Mabuchi functional proper，以 normalized flow 上的单调性推出收敛到 Kähler–Ricci soliton。
analysis.breakthrough: 确认 Apostolov–Streets–Ustinovskiy 的收敛猜想。
analysis.limitations: 初值要求 torus 不变，symplectic form 位于 2πc₁；不能直接推广到任意 generalized Kähler 初值。
